name: Trelane's Defenses
summary: Ogres now ring the Tower of Arathor, and Skuerto needs its defenses working. An azure agate from the Boulderfist shaman can become a key after Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe enchants it.

sections.title: The Tower's Defenses
sections.body: In Stromgarde, ogres ring the Tower of Arathor. Skuerto says you need to activate its defenses to have a chance against them. Only then can you reach the items alive.

sections.title: A Gem for a Key
sections.body: The Boulderfist shaman took certain gems from the tower and have grown fond of them. Skuerto says they will not keep the gems for long. Bring an azure agate to Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe. Kryten knows the spell that will enchant it to work as a key.

faq.q: Why is an azure agate needed?
faq.answer: Skuerto wants the tower's defenses active so you can face the ogres around the Tower of Arathor and reach the items alive. Enchanted, the gem will work as a key.

faq.q: Where did the azure agates come from?
faq.answer: The Boulderfist shaman took the azure agates from the Tower of Arathor and have grown fond of them.

aliases: who turns it into a key
faq.answer: Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe knows the spell to enchant the gem so it works as a key.
